answer: Under EigenTrust matrix factorization, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service keeps an agent’s score elevated. A freshly spawned sybil at dawn has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths; reciprocal collusion forms a hollow cluster, and transitivity-weighted links cannot bootstrap it. Attempts to spiral identities through the graph therefore lose weight before they can pass consensus.
